weapons.tooltipNemesisRpm:
Approximate number of rounds the weapon can fire in a minute. Calculations include chamber reload time, burst fire delay, charge-up time, and cooldown time where applicable.
• RPM reaches its maximum after firing 6 bursts.
weapons.tooltipNemesisRpmTurbo:
Approximate number of rounds the weapon can fire in a minute. Calculations include chamber reload time, burst fire delay, charge-up time, and cooldown time where applicable.
• With Turbocharger, RPM reaches its maximum after firing 2 bursts.
weapons.tooltipNemesisDps:
Damage per second dealt by continuous fire to the body.
• DPS reaches its maximum after firing 6 bursts.
weapons.tooltipNemesisDpsTurbo:
Damage per second dealt by continuous fire to the body.
• With Turbocharger, DPS reaches its maximum after firing 2 bursts.
weapons.tooltipDevotionRpm:
Approximate number of rounds the weapon can fire in a minute. Calculations include chamber reload time, burst fire delay, charge-up time, and cooldown time where applicable.
• RPM spools up from 300 to 900 RPM over 1.75s of continuous fire.
weapons.tooltipDevotionRpmTurbo:
Approximate number of rounds the weapon can fire in a minute. Calculations include chamber reload time, burst fire delay, charge-up time, and cooldown time where applicable.
• With Turbocharger, RPM spools up from 408 to 900 RPM over 0.85s of continuous fire.
weapons.tooltipDevotionDps:
Damage per second dealt by continuous fire to the body.
• DPS increases from 80 to 240 DPS over 1.75s of continuous fire.
weapons.tooltipDevotionDpsTurbo:
Damage per second dealt by continuous fire to the body.
• With Turbocharger, DPS increases from 109 to 240 DPS over 0.85s of continuous fire.
weapons.tooltipHavocRpm:

Approximate number of rounds the weapon can fire in a minute. Calculations include chamber reload time, burst fire delay, charge-up time, and cooldown time where applicable.

weapons.tooltip3030:

weapons.tooltipBocek:
Damage per second dealt by continuous fire to the body.

weapons.tooltipDps: Damage per second dealt by continuous fire to the body.
weapons.tooltipRpm: Approximate number of rounds the weapon can fire in a minute. Calculations include chamber reload time, burst fire delay, charge-up time, and cooldown time where applicable.
weapons.tooltipMag: The maximum number of rounds that can be stored in the weapon's magazine.
weapons.tooltipReload: The amount of time it takes to completely reload the weapon when the magazine is completely empty.
weapons.tooltipBreachReload: Cooldown time for the underbarrel launcher.
weapons.tooltipHandling: The relative speed and control of a weapon while firing compared to all other weapons. Factors include: Draw speed, Holster speed, Aim down sight speed, and Aim sway.
weapons.tooltipRecoil: The relative degree of recoil control of a weapon while firing compared to all other weapons.
weapons.tooltipHipfire: The relative degree of accuracy of a weapon while firing from the hip compared to all other weapons.

tutorial.step1_desc: Discover Nessie-Sensei, your ultimate data terminal for the Apex Legends universe. Let us show you around.
tutorial.step_team_format_desc: Switch between Duo or Trio so the algorithm generates the perfect composition for that mode.
tutorial.step_team_profile_desc: Here is the team's profile (Aggressive, Defensive, etc.) and its calculated synergy efficiency.
tutorial.step_team_save_desc: Crucial step: after your match, enter your placement (Top 1 to 20). The algorithm will refine its future proposals based on your performance!
tutorial.step_pack_level_desc: Enter your account level. There are 4 tiers (Prestige) up to level 500, which grant a lot of free packs.
tutorial.step_pack_seasons_desc: Set your level for each season and check the box if you bought the Premium Pass. Pro tip: not sure if you bought it? Check if you have the displayed weapon skin in your locker!
tutorial.step_prob_desc: We selected Pathfinder for you! Observe the results: the AI calculates which legends he statistically has the best chance to be optimally played with.
tutorial.step_feedback_desc: Click here to report a bug, suggest an improvement idea, submit a Fanart, or review this tutorial at any time!
